dialogues.speaker: Vindia
dialogues.text: Honestly, there wasn't much of a difference. When I was Queen, my only job was to smile and nod. Having nothing better to do, I spent my time penning fairy tales in secret.

dialogues.speaker: Vindia
dialogues.text: Whether it was surrendering to the Remurians or to the High King{RUBY#[D]Errighenth} of Aremorica, those were decisions made by the regency elders.

dialogues.speaker: Vindia
dialogues.text: So, you see, even when that deity brought me to this place, no one actually cared.

dialogues.speaker: Vindia
dialogues.text: Besides, this way, I won't be forced to go to Aremorica to pay my respects, put on a fake smile, and listen to those barbarians who don't even bathe...

dialogues.speaker: Vindia
dialogues.text: Sorry, I meant my venerable compatriots. Anyway, I'm spared from listening to them and that woman bickering endlessly over how many people they should kill. Honestly, she deserves to stay single for the rest of her life. A wonderful ending, wouldn't you say?
